config.label: Delegation and follow-up processes per rolling hour: decimal integer 1 to 9007199254740991; unset means unrestricted
config.description: Delegation and follow-up processes per rolling hour: decimal integer 1 to 9007199254740991; unset means unrestricted. In memory per server; probes never count.

config.label: Cap on running background jobs: decimal integer 1 to 8 (default 8)
config.description: Cap on running background jobs: decimal integer 1 to 8 (default 8). Blocking calls do not use this cap.

config.label: Opt-in local usage log: on or off (default off)
config.description: Opt-in local usage log: on or off (default off). Records counts and settings, never prompts, code or paths; labels are caller text.

config.label: Model used when a call names none
config.description: Model used when a call names none. Unset: the only entry of a single-entry CODEX_SUBAGENT_ALLOWED_MODELS, otherwise a call without a model is refused with a suggestion.

config.label: Reasoning effort used when a call specifies none: none, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max or ultra
config.description: Reasoning effort used when a call specifies none: none, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max or ultra. Unset: the model's own default. Cannot exceed CODEX_SUBAGENT_MAX_EFFORT.

config.label: Comma-separated allow-list of model slugs; anything else is refused
config.description: Comma-separated allow-list of model slugs; anything else is refused. Unset: unrestricted. A single entry acts as the default model; an empty entry is a configuration error.

config.label: Sandbox used when a call specifies none: read-only, workspace-write or danger-full-access
config.description: Sandbox used when a call specifies none: read-only, workspace-write or danger-full-access. Defaults to read-only and cannot exceed the ceiling.

config.label: Ceiling on what a delegation may do: read-only, workspace-write or danger-full-access
config.description: Ceiling on what a delegation may do: read-only, workspace-write or danger-full-access. Defaults to workspace-write; danger-full-access must be set explicitly.

config.label: Ceiling on reasoning effort: none, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max or ultra
config.description: Ceiling on reasoning effort: none, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max or ultra. Unset: unrestricted. Higher efforts are lowered to a supported level, or refused if none fits.

config.label: MCP servers from Codex's config a delegation keeps: none (default), all, or comma-separated names
config.description: MCP servers from Codex's config a delegation keeps: none (default), all, or comma-separated names.

config.label: Installed Codex plugins a delegation keeps: none (default), all, or comma-separated name@marketplace ids
config.description: Installed Codex plugins a delegation keeps: none (default), all, or comma-separated name@marketplace ids.

config.label: Whether a delegation keeps Codex's apps (connectors to external services): off (default) or on
config.description: Whether a delegation keeps Codex's apps (connectors to external services): off (default) or on.

config.label: Codex executable name or path
config.description: Codex executable name or path. Unset: codex, searched on PATH. On Windows it must run directly, such as codex.exe; a .cmd or .bat shim is refused.
